prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live local listings, so I can’t point to a single always-best salon right now — but I can help you pick the best spot in Tyler quickly. A couple quick questions first:

- Do you want UV tanning (beds) or spray/tanning solution only?
- Any location or budget preferences?

While you answer, here’s how to find the best tanning salon and what to look for:

How to find top salons in Tyler
- Check Google Maps and Yelp for 4★+ places and read recent reviews (last 6–12 months).
- Ask locals on Facebook, Nextdoor, or friends for personal referrals.
- Look at the salon’s website or social pages for photos, pricing, and promotions.

What to check when evaluating a salon
- Cleanliness: facility and changing/tanning rooms should be spotless.
- Equipment: newer/high-pressure beds give better, faster results with fewer sessions. Ask how often bulbs are changed and beds cleaned.
- Spray options: airbrush vs booth, and whether a trained technician does spray-tans for color consistency.
- Staff knowledge: staff should ask about your skin type, medications, and recommend a safe schedule.
- Safety: goggles provided, clear instructions on session length and intervals, and patch-test policy for new spray tans.
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions vs monthly memberships and packages.
- Hygiene & COVID practices: good ventilation and sanitized booths.

Safety tips
- Consider spray tans if you want color without UV exposure — they’re safer for skin health.
- If you use UV beds: limit sessions, follow recommended exposure times, wear protective eyewear, and never use tanning beds if you’re on photosensitizing meds or have fair skin that burns easily.
- Talk to a dermatologist if you have a personal or family history of skin cancer.

If you want, tell me which type (UV or spray) and your neighborhood/ZIP and I’ll compile a short list of likely top-rated salons and what to ask when you call them.
